name: Cheesy Chicken, Broccoli, and Rice
author: Chari Crawley
steps: In a large skillet or pan, sauté 1/2 of the yellow onions in two tablespoons of olive oil over medium heat. Season 1 lbs of chicken with salt and pepper.
Once onions soften, increase the heat to medium high and add chicken to the pan
Brown the chicken pieces and add the 2 cloves of garlic. Cook for about 1 more minute.
Push chicken to one side of the pan and add additional tablespoon of olive oil to other side.
Add the 1 cup of uncooked rice in the olive oil and saute it for a couple of minutes.
Add the 2 1/2 cups of chicken broth to the pan and bring the mixture to a boil. Lower the heat to a simmer and cover the pan with a lid.
Cook chicken and rice mixture covered for about 12 minutes.
Sprinkle the 2 1/2 cups of broccoli evenly over the chicken and rice mixture and stir to combine.
Continue to cook covered another 8 minutes on low, or until broccoli and rice are both tender.
Remove from heat and stir in half a cup of cheese.
Sprinkle remaining cheese on top and cover with a lid, letting it sit for 1-2 minutes or until cheese has melted.
